info.title: Office Integration
info.description:
This service provides APIs to enable building a single integration
to access Drive, Email, and Calendar features in different productivity suites.

This service currently only supports Microsoft 365, but may support other 
services such as Google Workspace in the future.

## Microsoft 365 Features
 - Access to files in a connected user's OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams.
 - Access to read & send email in a connected user's Outlook account.
 - Access to calendar events in a connected user's Outlook calendar.

## Connection Options
Credentials to this service can be obtained using the [Integration Engine Self Service Connection flow](https://dev.azure.com/ECISpecialProject/MFG-Integrations/_wiki/wikis/MFG-Integrations.wiki/92/Integration-Connection-Flow).

Currently the connection process supports Microsoft 365 OAuth2 Authorization Code flow, meaning each end user will
be authorizing and connecting their individual user accounts. Each credential issued is associated
with a single Microsoft 365 user.

In the future, this connection will also support OAuth2 Client Credentials for Service Principal authentication.

## Authentication

You can authenticate with this API using an JWT Bearer token in an HTTP header as shown below:

```Authorization: Bearer <token>```

## Service Information 

Build Version: `1.2.6+79ad6ecb58`

get.description:
Gets a list of drives available from the backing storage provider.
- For Microsoft 365, returns a list of all OneDrive, Sharepoint, and Team Site drives.

Gets a list of items in the drive, optionally filtered by the search criteria if provided.
- For Microsoft 365, returns a list of items in the selected drive.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Drive id

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search query

get.description:
Gets calendar events from the connected user's personal calendar, optionally filtered by the start and end date.
- For Microsoft 365, gets events from the connected user’s Outlook Calendar.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start date of the events to retrieve

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end date of the events to retrieve

post.description:
Creates a new calendar event in the connected user's personal calendar.
- For Microsoft 365, creates a new event in the connected user’s Outlook Calendar.

requestBody.description: The request containing the details of the calendar event to be created.

get.summary: Get a calendar event by Id.
get.description:
Gets a calendar event from the connected user's personal calendar by its Id.
- For Microsoft 365, gets an event from the connected user’s Outlook Calendar by Id.

patch.description:
Updates an existing calendar event in the connected user's personal calendar.
- For Microsoft 365, updates an event in the connected user’s Outlook Calendar.

delete.description:
Deletes a calendar event from the connected user's personal calendar.
- For Microsoft 365, deletes an event from the connected user’s Outlook Calendar.

get.description:
Gets the user's personal drive.
- For Microsoft 365, returns the user's personal drive.

Gets a list of items in the user's drive, optionally filtered by the search criteria if provided.
- For Microsoft 365, returns a list of items in the user's drive.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search query

get.description:
Gets a list of files that the user has recently accessed, sorted by most recently accessed first.
- For Microsoft 365, returns a list of recently accessed files.

post.description:
Sends an email message using the connected mail account.
- For Microsoft 365, sends an email from the connected user's Outlook mailbox.

get.description:
Gets a list of mail messages in the specified folder.

- For Microsoft 365, returns a list of messages in the specified folder.

If no parameters are specified, the default is to return the most recent 25 messages in the folder, oldest to newest.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: The folder to get messages from

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Limit the number of results. The default value is 25 if not specified.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Limit the results to messages received since the given date. Default is last 3 days.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Limit the results to messages received before the given date.

parameters.name: next_page_token
parameters.description: The next page token from a previous request. If this value is provided, all other parameters will be ignored.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: Indicates the sort order for mail items. Default is oldest first.

get.description:
Gets a mail message by ID.

- For Microsoft 365, returns a list of messages in the specified folder.

If no parameters are specified, the default is to return the most recent 25 messages in the folder.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: The folder to get messages from

get.description:
Gets a list of attachments for a specific message.
- For Microsoft 365, returns a list of attachments for a message.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: The folder to get messages from

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The message id to get attachments from

get.description:
Gets a message attachment by ID
- For Microsoft 365, gets the message attachment including it's contents.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: The folder to get messages from

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The message id to get attachments from

parameters.name: attachmentId
parameters.description: The attachment id to download

get.description:
Downloads a specific attachment from a message.
- For Microsoft 365, downloads an attachment from a message.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: The folder to get messages from

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The message id to get attachments from

parameters.name: attachmentId
parameters.description: The attachment id to download

get.description:
Gets a list of mail messages, and provides a nextPageToken in the response that can be used to fetch messages that have only changed since the previous request.
Each subsequent request will generate a new nextPageToken in the response that can be used to make a subsequent request. Only the 'top' parameter can be specified in subsequent requests combined with next_page_token. - For Microsoft 365, returns a list of messages in the specified folder, or messages that have arrived since the previous request. If no parameters are specified, the default is to return the most recent 25 messages in the folder, oldest to newest.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: The folder to get messages from

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Limit the number of results. The default value is 25 if not specified.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Limit the results to messages received since the given date. Default is last 3 days if not specified.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Limit the results to messages received before the given date.

parameters.name: next_page_token
parameters.description: The next page token from a previous request. If this value is provided, all other parameters will be ignored.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: Indicates the sort order for mail items. Default is oldest first.
